sentences.text: An API bearer token is valid for 3600 seconds after it is issued.
To get a new token, a client calls POST /auth/token with its client id and client secret, and sends the new token before the old one expires.
After a client secret is rotated, the old secret keeps working for 15 minutes so that deployments can be updated without downtime.
Company passwords are not rotated on a fixed schedule, and must be changed immediately if there is any suspicion that they were exposed.
WireGuard keys for VPN devices are rotated every 90 days by the device management system, and a device that is not rotated in time loses access until it is updated.

draft.missing: The passages give a lifetime only for API bearer tokens (3600 seconds) and a grace period for old client secrets after rotation. They do not state how long other access credentials, such as company passwords or privileged sessions in terms of issuance, remain usable in general. The passages also do not say how long an access grant lasts; access is reviewed quarterly.
